_doc: Local-2B AGENT/SURFACE BASELINE spectrum. Steward mandate 2026-07-22: profile the agents that are NOT yet profiled against the llama.cpp 2B running locally, so the potato machine (Intel HD 620, ~2B GGUF) has a recorded BASELINE. profile_local_2b.py enumerates the REAL agent tasks (goal_seeding.SEED_BOOTSTRAP_GOALS + the flagship catalog) -- this file holds only the per-CATEGORY probes + budgets, so there is no parallel list of agents (Gate 4: the goal list stays single-source). Budgets are for a ~2B GGUF on the HD 620; a bigger box beats them, so a FAIL is a real regression, not a machine excuse.

endpoint._note: The canonical llama-server OpenAI endpoint the agents already use (port_registry 'llm'; env HART_LLM_PORT). NOT a parallel inference path -- we route to the shared server, never reimplement.

budgets._note: Per single-turn probe on the 2B. first_token_ms = responsiveness; total_ms = full short completion; min_chars = the model actually answered (not an empty/garbage reply).

categories._note: Each agent task from the real goal list is mapped to ONE category by keyword (profiler does the mapping); the category names its probe style + budget class. The probe is a SHORT single-turn stand-in for the agent's LLM step, so the baseline measures the model's behaviour on that KIND of work.

marketing.probe: Write a one-sentence launch tagline for an open, crowdsourced AI operating system.

referral.probe: Write a one-line referral invite a user would send a friend.

video.probe: Write a 2-line script hook for a 30-second product demo video.

intelligence.probe: In 2 sentences, explain why decentralized compute resists monopoly.

monitor.probe: Given metrics {cpu:12%, agents:3, errors:0}, state one health verdict in one line.

analytics.probe: Given signups grew 10 to 82, state the growth multiple and one next action.

coding.probe: In one line, what does a Python function that returns len(set(x)) compute?

audit.probe: List two things to check when auditing a repo for a missing dependency.

revenue.probe: Extract the number: 'API revenue this week was 1240 dollars'. Reply with only the number.

finance.probe: In one line, why keep 3 months of runway in a self-sustaining business?

exception.probe: From 'ERROR: No module named torch', reply with only the missing module name.

generic.probe: Reply with a single word: acknowledged.

surfaces._note: UI-adjacent agent surfaces whose LLM turn should also have a baseline (the shell composes via A2UI = an LLM turn). Latency-to-photon is covered by latency_budgets.json; THIS measures the model turn behind them.

a2ui_compose.probe: Return a JSON object {"hero":"..."} with a one-line greeting for a desktop home screen.

voice_reply.probe: Reply conversationally in one short sentence to: 'what's the weather like'.

recipe_step.probe: Given the step 'search the web for X', state in one line what the agent should do.
